nodes.label: Round-Robin Scheduling
nodes.rationale: Round-robin provides simple scheduling across available providers without worker threads or load prediction.

nodes.label: Length-Prefixed Framing
nodes.rationale: A fixed-width network-order length handles arbitrary text split across TCP reads.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only integrity gate surfaces dangling or missing endpoints, self-loops, and collapsed edges.

nodes.label: Deterministic Node IDs
nodes.rationale: Repository-relative IDs align semantic and AST extraction and prevent duplicates.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Queries use only tokens found in graph labels because matching has no stemming, synonym, or cross-language support.

nodes.label: Query Feedback Memory
nodes.rationale: Saved answers, outcomes, and corrections guide future queries toward useful sources and away from dead ends.

nodes.label: Corpus-Derived Whisper Prompt
nodes.rationale: A one-sentence domain hint from corpus labels improves transcription without another API call.

nodes.label: Portable Extraction Manifest
nodes.rationale: Manifest paths are relative to the scan root so updates survive clones and moves.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-Extraction
nodes.rationale: Changed sources are replaced during merge; pruning is reserved for deleted files.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: Documents, papers, and images use Gemini when configured or the host agent otherwise.

nodes.label: Structural AST Extraction
nodes.rationale: Code structure is extracted deterministically without an LLM or API key.

nodes.label: Validate Weight Reuse
nodes.rationale: Repeated Qwen3 model preparation dominates request latency and is unsuitable for interactive service.

nodes.label: Amortized Model Preparation
nodes.rationale: Verified model bytes and loaded weights should be reused across requests to avoid repeated transfer and loading.
